title: Application FAQs
lede_html: Have questions about applying to the University of Maryland? You've come to the right place.
body_html: We know applying to college is a lot of work, so we'll do everything we can to make it as stress-free as possible. Use the links below for the quickest answers to many of the common questions we receive.

items.title: Freshman Application FAQs
items.description_html: Applying as a freshman? Save time by reviewing these frequently asked questions about completing your freshman application before contacting the Office of Undergraduate Admissions.

image.alt: View from above of student studying

items.title: Transfer Application FAQs
items.description_html: Applying as a transfer student? Review these frequently asked questions about completing your transfer application before contacting the Office of Undergraduate Admissions.

items.title: Submitting Documents
items.description_html: Applications are considered complete when the online application and all required documents have been submitted. Determine the best way to submit all of your required application documents.
items.cta_label: Learn how to submit application materials

image.alt: M Circle in front of Symons Hall at UMD

items.title: Essay Questions
items.description_html: The essay provides you with the opportunity to showcase aspects of your personality and experiences that fit well with UMD's community.
